subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing in these incident tickets.

judge.implied_focus: The nature and resolution of IT incidents -- characterizing what breaks (device/problem type), how severe/impactful it is, and how it gets resolved.

per_column.name: incident_device_type
per_column.rationale: Classifies the affected asset, a core facet of characterizing the incident.

per_column.name: problem_severity_level
per_column.rationale: Captures the failure mode/severity, central to understanding incident nature.

per_column.name: assigned_technician
per_column.rationale: Largely duplicates existing assigned_to; an operational actor field, not a facet of the incident-nature focus.

per_column.name: caller_identity
per_column.rationale: Duplicates existing caller_id; identity restatement, not a focus facet.

per_column.name: description_detail_level
per_column.rationale: A meta-attribute of the ticket describing symptom specificity, relevant to characterizing incidents.

per_column.name: systemic_recurrence
per_column.rationale: Recurring vs first-occurrence is a meaningful analytical facet of incident nature.

per_column.name: assignee_closure_alignment
per_column.rationale: A process/handoff metric orthogonal to the incident-characterization focus; adds a different concern (workflow integrity).

per_column.name: resolution_approach
per_column.rationale: How the incident was resolved, a coherent facet tied to incident type and outcome.

per_column.name: business_impact_domain
per_column.rationale: Impact facet, directly supports prioritizing what's worth analyzing.

judge.rationale: A clear majority of the added columns (device_type, problem_severity, description_detail_level, systemic_recurrence, resolution_approach, business_impact_domain) cohere around one inferable focus: characterizing IT incidents by their nature, resolution, and impact -- a genuinely useful analytical structure with differentiated facets at good granularity. This is neither a single restatement nor pure noise, and the focus is actionable (an analyst could investigate recurring device failures, high-impact categories, or resolution patterns). However, coherence is diluted by three columns: assigned_technician and caller_identity merely restate existing assigned_to/caller_id (identity fields, not focus facets), and assignee_closure_alignment injects a separate process-integrity concern. This grab-bag element and the redundancy prevent higher marks on coherence and structure.
